verdicts.criticalReason: BARCAN-TAG-09/specification_coverage: The merged PRs completely fail to address the core requirements in the client brief. There are no changes addressing the HTTP 401 errors on employee dossier endpoints, nor is there any implementation for the Moodle SSO integration.

BARCAN-TAG-05/causal_unjustified: PR #1081 changes the Docker backup script mount from a file to a directory to address an initialization permission error. However, this change only correlates with the symptom going away and does not trace or modify the actual underlying execution permission mechanism.
